contract_answer.question: Does the registered prefix-drift term (loss.md 4.7 row: lambda*mean|f(x_trunc)-f(x)|, j = floor(u*i), u ~ U(0.5,1), anchor 'both', both views dropout-free, rho 0.5) lower the held-out relative drift of NA-E009 by >= 50% on split 2021 without MAPE > 0.1049, BALANCE_FAIL, or a 76-100 prefix-band MAPE regression > 0.01?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewer recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (best epoch 9 of 13, early stop; minimum-MAPE epoch 8 at 0.1008, inside the 0.005 tolerance): MAPE 0.1019, Acc@15 0.705, RMSE 24.04, bias -16.19 cycles, prediction/target std ratio 1.03, vs NA-E009 0.0999 / 0.743 / 22.53 / -15.91 / 0.75. All of the lead's numbers match. Pre-registered rule: MAPE 0.1019 <= 0.1049 PASS; loss_balance PASS (median R 0.350, samples 0.368 and 0.332, cosine +0.38 then -0.94, active fraction 0.30/0.27, lambda 0.0181); 76-100 band MAPE 0.118456 vs 0.108492 = +0.009963, which is under the 0.01 guard by only 0.00004 (PASS, barely); held-out relative drift (tools/posthoc_drift.py, BL_SPLIT=2021, eval mode, seed 0) 0.0226 vs 0.0264 = -14.4%, far short of the required -50% (<= 0.0132). The run fails the drift criterion, so the decision is DISCARD. Band MAPE (candidate/parent): 1-10 0.0954/0.1221, 11-25 0.0773/0.0936, 26-50 0.0979/0.0928, 51-75 0.1068/0.0932, 76-100 0.1185/0.1085. Band drift: 1-10 0.032/0.086 (-63%), 11-25 0.038/0.049, 26-50 0.019/0.017, 51-75 0.014/0.012, 76-100 0.022/0.014 (+60%). The term fixed the short prefixes but made long-prefix predictions less consistent and less accurate.

main_symptom: Drift fell only 14.4% (0.0264 -> 0.0226). It fell 63% in the 1-10 band but rose 60% in the 76-100 band, and MAPE got worse from prefix 26 onward (+0.005 / +0.014 / +0.010), while 1-10 and 11-25 improved (-0.027 / -0.016).

causes.class: objective mechanism: two-sided drift sends gradient into the informed long-prefix prediction
supporting_evidence: tools/posthoc_drift.py bands: 76-100 drift 0.0218 vs 0.0136 (+60%), 26-50 and 51-75 also up
contradicting_evidence: Signed error by band does not show long predictions moving up toward the short ones: 1-10 moved +0.040 -> -0.026 (short pulled down toward long), 76-100 moved -0.109 -> -0.116. The long-band damage looks like extra variance (std ratio 0.75 -> 1.03), not a level pull toward short-prefix values.
causes.interpretation: With anchor 'both', |f(x_trunc)-f(x)| sends equal gradient to the long view f(x). The long-prefix prediction has more ageing evidence and should not move. Here it absorbs part of the correction, and with the main loss opposing the term (cosine -0.94) its errors spread out more. This explains why short prefixes got better while long prefixes and long-view drift got worse. The mechanism is the extra freedom of the long view, not a pure mean pull.
missing_evidence: Per-pair breakdown of which view moved during training (gradient share between f(x) and f(x_trunc))

causes.class: balance strength: rho 0.5 is too small for the drift target
supporting_evidence: diagnostics.json$.epoch_history[*] (val MAPE 0.152 -> 0.101 by epoch 8, then 0.121-0.147; stop at epoch 13)
contradicting_evidence: The 1-10 band drift already fell 63%, so the term is strong enough where it acts; raising rho would also scale up C1's long-view damage (51-75 already +0.0136)
causes.interpretation: A larger lambda could push total drift further down, but the rise in 76-100 drift and long-band MAPE shows that the extra strength would go partly into the wrong view. So a stronger symmetric term is not the right repair.
missing_evidence: A rho sweep (not allowed as a multi-change; one value per experiment)

supporting_evidence: diagnostics.json$.epoch_history[*] (selected epoch 9; epoch 8 0.1008; MAPE swings 0.10-0.15 between epochs)
contradicting_evidence: The band pattern (short better, long worse) is monotonic and matches the drift bands, which noise is unlikely to produce
causes.interpretation: With 6 cells one cell can move a band by ~0.01, so the 76-100 guard margin (0.00004) carries no information. But the drift shortfall (-14% vs -50%) is too large to be noise.
